textData.text: In this episode, I share my personal journey through the world of video games, starting with my first game, Kirby's Adventure, and spanning across various genres including Mario, Pokemon, and rhythm games like Deemo and BanG Dream. I talk about my profound experiences with games like Fire Emblem, Final Fantasy XIV, and Genshin Impact, and how these games shaped my love for storytelling, challenges, and community. Now, I embark on a new adventure to create a video game journal, sharing my explorations, encounters, and passions with you all. Join me as I turn this channel into a haven for game lovers and fellow explorers.
